meta.canonicalRule: spec.json is the canonical machine registry and spec.md is the implementer guide. Current checks prove JSON integrity and stable registry coverage only; they do not claim sentence-level or full semantic parity.

sourceSeams: All 21 production field names and enum/range validation are canonical; editor rows add only stable id in editorV2.
WorkPlanStructured | PermitInspectionStructured | TbmBriefingStructured | TbmLogStructured | EducationRecordStructured | TbmRiskLink
Known fields project to these existing structured payloads; richer v2-only fields remain in editorV2 and export manifests.
Current edit invalidates ontologyQa, qualityContract, and dbHarness; v2 extends invalidation to generationEvidence and generationEvidenceError.
Current full regeneration seam calls runAsk then attachGenerationEvidence; it is the fallback when no verified base exists, not an edit-preserving revalidator.

The seal exists only at top-level AskResponse.generationEvidence. buildResponseContentDigest deletes only top-level generationEvidence/generationEvidenceError before hashing the remaining canonical response; editorV2 never nests either field.
V2 review mode must attach a verdict without auto-mutating structured editor content; failed review returns blocking issues.
Quality is recomputed only after deterministic editor projection and ontology review.
Current authoritative persistence is insert-only and requires valid generation evidence; v2 preserves immutable inserts and adds server-stamped human confirmation.
Existing deliverables/evidence_summary/status JSONB carry editorV2, structured data, review metadata, and seals without a migration.
Current authority derives legacy readiness but does not verify editor block identity/revision/digest. Wave 4 owns that extension; v2 share remains blocked until it lands.
Stores share-session read acknowledgment only; it cannot satisfy TBM attendance, understanding, signature, or safety confirmation.
POST returns improvementId but not photo row id/storagePath; GET returns improvements and photo_summary but not workpack_improvement_photos.
Existing patterns prove body/metadata separation is already recognized for export; v2 moves the boundary into a shared lossless adapter used before editing.
Current generation concatenates provenance into strings; v2 projects those appendices into separate evidence/review roots and never binds the combined string to an editor.
Hardcoded URLs are untrusted candidates, including guidanceX.do.
Only current runtime verified=true HTTPS results may become drawer links.
Current user edits propagate to workpack readiness; v2 passes canonical envelope changes and explicit revalidation invalidation through this call site.
Current reopen seam hydrates stored deliverables/evidence_summary/status; adapter precedence begins from the authoritative stored JSON.
Existing structured modes remain; v2 adds the deterministic hidden manifest and never drops richer fields.
Visible PDF body uses submission content; deterministic provenance/audit appendix and field-path manifest remain outside editable body semantics.
Existing HWP-compatible output remains; v2 appends deterministic semantic data outside the editable body.
All formats consume one ExportManifestBridge; current document-specific structured projections remain compatibility views.

Current POST accepts recipients only and persists no editor document/block/revision/digest binding. Wave 4 must validate and store that binding in existing access_policy JSONB before v2 share unlocks.

Current allowed fields reject client freshness fields and load a session without access_policy binding. Wave 4 keeps the client request shape, loads the server session binding, and rejects stale or missing bindings before provider dispatch.
